definitions.gloss: inner loop (of a circular train line)
definitions.explanation: On a circular railway such as Tokyo's Yamanote Line, the trains running on the inner track. On the Yamanote Line they run counterclockwise.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山手線|やまのてせん}→山手線：30709_yamanotesen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{内回|うちまわ}り。
examples.english: The inner loop of the Yamanote Line.
At this time of day the inner loop is less crowded.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山手線|やまのてせん}→山手線：30709_yamanotesen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{内回|うちまわ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{反時計回|はんとけいまわ}り、⟦{外回|そとまわ}り→外回り：17708_sotomawari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{時計回|とけいまわ}り→時計回り：20525_tokeimawari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{走|はし}っている→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
examples.english: On the Yamanote Line, the inner loop runs counterclockwise and the outer loop clockwise.

notes:
Station signs and announcements on loop lines name the direction this way, usually with a few major stations ahead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {内回|うちまわ}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧: an inner-loop train
- {内回|うちまわ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧: to take the inner loop

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{外回|そとまわ}り→外回り：17708_sotomawari⟧: outer loop; also sales rounds outside the office
